#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

class TaskC {
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, PrintWriter& out) {
        int a = in.nextInt();
        int b = in.nextInt();
        int l = in.nextInt();
        int r = in.nextInt();

        out << fun(a, b, l, r) << endl;
    }

    int fun(int a, int b, int l, int r) {
        if ((r - l + 1) > 2 * (a + b))
            if (a <= b)
                return a + 1;
            else
                return (2 * a - b);

        vector<int> flag(3 * (a + b) + 1);

        int temp = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= a; i++) {
            flag[i] = i;
            temp = i;
        }

        for (int i = a + 1; i <= a + b; i++) {
            flag[i] = temp;
        }

        for (int i = a + b + 1; i <= a + b + a; i++) {
            int tc = 1;
            while (in(flag, tc, a + b - a + 1, i - 1))
                tc++;
            flag[i] = tc;
            temp = flag[i];
        }
        for (int i = a + b + a + 1; i <= a + b + a + b; i++) {
            flag[i] = temp;
        }
        for (int i = 2 * (a + b) + 1; i <= 3 * (a + b); i++) {
            flag[i] = flag[i - (a + b)];
        }

        vector<int> flagc(25);
        int templ = l % (a + b);
        if (templ == 0) templ += a + b;
        int tempr = r - l + templ;
        if (tempr < templ) tempr += a + b;
        for (int i = templ; i <= tempr; i++) {
            flagc[flag[i]] = 1;
        }

        int res = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 24; i++)
            res += flagc[i];

        return res;

    }

    bool in(vector<int>& a, int b, int l, int r) {
        for (int i = l; i <= r; i++) {
            if (a[i] == b)
                return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

};

class InputReader {
public:
    InputReader() {}
    InputReader(std::istream& stream) : stream_(stream) {}

    int read() {
        if (numChars_ == -1) {
            throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
        }
        if (curChar_ >= numChars_) {
            curChar_ = 0;
            try {
                numChars_ = stream_.read(buf_, 1024);
            } catch (std::exception& e) {
                throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            }
            if (numChars_ <= 0) {
                return -1;
            }
        }
        return buf_[curChar_++];
    }

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isSpaceChar(c)) {
            c = read();
        }
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sgn = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') {
                throw std::runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            }
            res *= 10;
            res += c - '0';
            c = read();
        } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }

    bool isSpaceChar(int c) {
        return isWhitespace(c);
    }

    bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }

private:
    std::istream& stream_;
    char buf_[1024];
    int curChar_ = 0;
    int numChars_ = 0;
};

int main() {
    std::ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    std::cin.tie(nullptr);
    InputReader in(std::cin);
    PrintWriter out(std::cout);
    TaskC solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    out.close();
    return 0;
}
